construction: 79 parts in 9 steps plus six children. Step 1: child `128`, three 1×1 bricks with studs on four sides. Step 5: child `129`, a nose with cones and tiles on a four-sided-stud brick. Step 6: two wedge hull-side children `130`, turned to +X and −X. Step 7: two `131` children, red plates with round greebles. Step 8: child `132`, the engine block, with round bricks and plates as the engines. Step 9: child `133`, the clear display stand.
interfaces: Stud directions: 79 parts, 44 −Z, 17 up, 8 each ±X. The parent matrix `0 0 1 / 0 1 0 / −1 0 0` turns it 90° about Y.
lesson: A micro ship built sideways along its length on bricks with studs on four sides.
parent_context: The micro Tantive IV on its clear stand beside the Star Destroyer (`10030 - main.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Build a long, thin micro hull along a column of four-sided-stud bricks; compare s16, whose wings stand on clips instead.
